# Is the consumer engine of the economy starting to slow down?

Consumer sentiment tumbled in early August, according to the University of Michigan survey. July retail sales were down more than half a percent from June, and AAA reports the nationwide average gas price neared a record high for August.

results.content: # Economic Optimism Falls For First Time In 3 Months—As Republican Sentiment Nears 2-Year Low. Ty Roush is a breaking news reporter based in New York City. Views on the U.S. economy fell unexpectedly in August, ending two months of improvement after the war in Iran lowered economic optimism to a record low, according to a widely tracked University of Michigan survey, as sentiment among Republicans fell to its lowest level in nearly two years. The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment reading—a monthly survey of Americans’ views on the economy—fell to 51 in August from 55.2 in July, dropping well below consensus analyst estimates of 54.5, according to FactSet.
